message.content:
在標準的撲克牌遊戲（例如德州撲克）中，每位玩家手上都只有兩張「底牌」，而桌面上的公共牌則是所有玩家共享的。  
因此，沒有任何一個玩家會比其他人手上持有更多的紙牌；每位玩家手中的紙牌數量相同。  

如果你指的是「發牌者」或「莊家」的角色，他們負責發牌但不會額外持有紙牌，除非在某些特殊變體（如荷官保留一張底牌作為莊家牌）中才會有差異。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "在撲克牌遊戲中，誰擁有最多的紙牌？" which translates to "In a poker game, who has the most cards?" They want to know who holds the most cards. In standard poker games like Texas Hold'em, each player gets two private cards (hole cards). But the dealer deals community cards to all players. So no one has more than others. However, if we consider the dealer or the pot? The question might be ambiguous. We can interpret as "In a poker game, who has the most cards?" The answer: In Texas Hold'em, each player has two cards; the dealer deals community cards to all players, so no one has more than others. If we consider the dealer's role, they deal but don't hold them. So the answer: No one has more than others; each player has equal number of cards.
